entities.name: Dorothy Bohm
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Dorothy Bohm was a Russian-born British photographer based in London, known for her portraiture, street photography, early adoption of colour, and photography of London and Paris; she is considered one of the doyennes of British photography.
